definitions.explanation: A musical instrument that generates or modifies sound using electronic circuits. Includes synthesizers, electronic keyboards, drum machines, and other digitally controlled instruments.

examples.japanese: {電子楽器|でんしがっき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}する→演奏する：20349_ensousuru⟧。
examples.english: To perform on an electronic instrument.

examples.japanese: ⟦シンセサイザー→シンセサイザー：17579_shinsesaizaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{代表的|だいひょうてき}→代表的：05670_daihyouteki⟧な{電子楽器|でんしがっき}だ。
examples.english: The synthesizer is a typical electronic instrument.

examples.japanese: {電子楽器|でんしがっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{普及|ふきゅう}→普及：07592_fukyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦オーケストラ→オーケストラ：04466_ookesutora⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|だ}せる→出す：01087_dasu⟧ようになった。
examples.english: With the spread of electronic instruments, even one person can produce orchestral sounds.

notes:
USAGE:
{電子楽器|でんしがっき} is a broad category encompassing any instrument that relies on electronic technology to produce sound. This includes keyboards, synthesizers, drum machines, and electronic wind instruments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電子楽器|でんしがっき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{弾|ひ}く→弾く：02444_hiku⟧ (to play an electronic instrument)
- {電子楽器|でんしがっき}⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧ (electronic instrument manufacturer)
- {電子楽器|でんしがっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音色|ねいろ}→音色：07422_neiro⟧ (sound/tone of an electronic instrument)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{楽器|がっき}→楽器：13159_gakki⟧ is the general word for musical instrument. ⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧ and ⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧オルガン are specific types of electronic instruments. {生楽器|なまがっき} (acoustic instrument) is the counterpart to {電子楽器|でんしがっき}.
